job_creation_from_scene.title: 电商订单与支付流水日对账

actual.summary: 创建电商订单与支付流水日对账作业，每天早上8点执行，按订单号匹配，检查支付金额和状态，金额允许1分钱差异。

job_creation_from_scene.rawText:
{
  "intent": "create_reconciliation_job_from_existing_scene",
  "needClarification": false,
  "systems": ["erp", "bank"],
  "matchKeys": ["transaction_id"],
  "compareMetrics": ["amount", "status"],
  "schedule": ["daily"],
  "tolerances": ["amount", "date"],
  "filters": ["optional_filter_code"],
  "summary": "创建电商订单与支付流水日对账作业，每天早上8点执行，按订单号匹配，检查支付金额和状态，金额允许1分钱差异。"
}
